mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause crystalline nephropathy; foscarnet increases risk of electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) which may be potentiated by sulfamethoxazole's effects on renal function.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; adjust dosing based on creatinine clearance.
